neighbours.label: the 'now is the time' construction: 'now is / now's' urging that the present is the right moment to act, peaking on the words before 'time', as opposed to clock time or 'now' as a plain temporal adverb
fire: If you ever wanted to visit Iceland, now is the time to book.
Prices have dropped, so now is the time to buy a bike.
Dear members, now is the time to renew your subscription.
With spring coming, now's the time to plant tomatoes.
Rates are low, and now is a great time to refinance your home.
The election is close; now is the time for every voter to speak up.
If you have stories to share, now's the time to tell them.
After years of waiting, now is the time to act on climate.
quiet: If you ever visited Iceland, you know how cold it gets.
Prices have dropped, so many people bought a bike last year.
Dear members, the meeting ended at the usual time.
With spring coming, the days are getting longer.
Rates are low, and the bank opens at nine on Mondays.
The election was close; the votes were counted by midnight.
She looked at her watch: it was now half past four.
After years of waiting, the old bridge now carries trains again.

predictions: fire 0.4-1.2 on ' now' / ' is' / ' the' in 'now is the time' and 'now is a great time'; 'the time is now 5pm', narrative 'now the ...', 'this is the place' below 0.15
notes: Card: peaks ' is' x15 in 'Now is the time', 'now's the time', 'this is the time'. Probe: 'now is the time to start' 1.181, 'Now is a good time to review' 0.708, 'Now's the moment' 0.521, 'this is the time' 0.325; 'The time is now three o'clock' 0.238, 'you should start soon' 0.225, 'Now the children are asleep' 0.064, 'This is the place' 0.087. Near misses use clock time or temporal 'now' without the urging frame.
